title: Gamepad Lab
author: Seth Morrow
description: Game controllers, through the gamepadxt extension. It opens playing five short showcases on a touch pad made in software: every button, the sticks and the dead zone, rumble with the light and player numbers, a button remapped, and a small game. Press a button on a controller of your own and it takes over: each button, stick and trigger lights up as it moves, beside the events each poll gathers. Drag the touch pad's sticks, or drive it with the arrow keys and Z X A S. Where gamepadxt is missing, the showcases play as a recording.
